plugins.name: AI 翻译
plugins.description: 选中文字后一键 AI 翻译，支持自动识别源语言和多目标语言切换
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Frequent context switching to translation tools disrupts workflow. This plugin embeds AI translation into the desktop—select text, get instant results.
purpose.zh: 在阅读外文资料、编写国际化代码或与海外同事沟通时，频繁切换翻译工具打断工作流。AI 翻译插件将翻译能力嵌入桌面，选中即译，让语言不再成为障碍。

en: Reading foreign docs: translate selected paragraphs instantly
Code comments: quickly understand foreign annotations
Cross-language communication: translate emails and messages
Language learning: translate vocabulary and example sentences
zh: 阅读外文文档：选中段落一键翻译，无需复制粘贴
代码注释翻译：快速理解外文注释和文档
跨语言沟通：翻译邮件、聊天消息后发送
学习辅助：翻译生词和例句，辅助语言学习

longDescription.en: AI Translator leverages advanced AI models to support one-click translation of selected text, with automatic source language detection and multi-target language switching.
longDescription.zh: AI 翻译插件利用先进的 AI 模型，支持选中文字后一键翻译，自动识别源语言并切换多目标语言，让跨语言沟通无障碍。

en: Automatic source language detection, no manual selection needed
Multi-target language switching (English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, etc.)
Quick Action panel integration—select text to translate
Standalone popup mode, translation results don't obscure original text
zh: 自动识别源语言，无需手动选择
多目标语言切换（英、日、韩、法、德等）
快捷操作面板集成，选中文本即可翻译
独立弹窗模式，翻译结果不遮挡原文

plugins.name: 加密解密工具箱
plugins.description: 本地加密解密与压缩工具：Base64/Hex/URL 编码、AES/ChaCha20/国密加解密、哈希摘要、经典密码、文件压缩成字符串与还原
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Developers constantly juggle encoded strings (Base64/Hex/JWT), digests, and cipher payloads between browsers, terminals, and docs — usually via random websites that leak data. This plugin bundles the full crypto/encoding workflow into one offline toolbox with zero-trace privacy.
purpose.zh: 开发者经常在浏览器、终端、文档之间来回处理编码字符串（Base64/Hex/JWT）、摘要与密文，通常求助随机网站、存在数据泄露风险。本插件把完整加密/编码工作流装进一个离线工具箱，零痕迹保护隐私。

en: Decode base64/hex/JWT strings from API responses during integration debugging
Compress a file into a base64 string, send it over any text channel, and restore it on the other side
Cross-check AES-256-GCM encryption between frontend (WebCrypto) and backend (openssl)
Solve CTF-style classical ciphers (Caesar brute force, Vigenere, rail fence) locally
zh: 联调时解码 API 响应里的 Base64/Hex/JWT 字符串
把文件压缩成 Base64 字符串，经任意文本通道发送后在对端还原
交叉验证前端（WebCrypto）与后端（openssl）的 AES-256-GCM 加密结果
本地破解 CTF 风格经典密码（凯撒枚举、维吉尼亚、栅栏）

longDescription.en: An offline cryptography and compression toolbox: 11 encoding schemes (Base16-85, URL, HTML entity, Unicode escape, Morse), hashing (MD5/SHA/SHA3/SM3/CRC32/HMAC), symmetric ciphers (AES all modes, ChaCha20, SM4, DES/3DES, RC4, Blowfish), RSA and JWT tooling, KDF (PBKDF2/Argon2id), classical ciphers, smart format detection, and two-way file-to-compressed-string transfer. All heavy computation runs in a local Rust sidecar — nothing ever leaves your device.
longDescription.zh: 离线加密与压缩工具箱：11 种编码（Base16-85、URL、HTML 实体、Unicode 转义、摩斯电码）、哈希（MD5/SHA 全系/SHA3/SM3/CRC32/HMAC）、对称加密（AES 全模式、ChaCha20、SM4、DES/3DES、RC4、Blowfish）、RSA 与 JWT 工具、密钥派生（PBKDF2/Argon2id）、经典密码、智能格式识别、文件⇄压缩字符串双向互转。重计算全部在本地 Rust sidecar 中完成——数据永不出设备。

en: 23 tools: encoding, hashing, symmetric/asymmetric ciphers, JWT, KDF, compression, generators
Smart detection: paste anything, get ranked candidates with confidence and one-click jump
QuickAction integration: decode/hash/parse selected text directly from the popup
File pipeline: hash / compress / Base64 / encrypt files up to 200MB with progress
Zero-trace: keys and plaintext never touch logs or disk cache
Live computing with 120ms adaptive debounce, all crypto in native Rust
zh: 23 个工具：编码、哈希、对称/非对称加密、JWT、KDF、压缩、生成器
智能识别：粘贴任意内容，按置信度排序候选并一键跳转预填
QuickAction 联动：弹窗中直接解码/哈希/解析选中文本
文件管线：哈希/压缩/Base64/加密最高 200MB 文件，带进度与取消
零痕迹：密钥与明文永不写日志、不落盘
即算模式 120ms 自适应防抖，全部密码学计算走原生 Rust

plugins.name: 内容对比工具
plugins.description: 文本/代码行级+词级对比、JSON 结构感知对比，差异清单快速定位
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Compare anything, not just code. This plugin provides line-level plus word-level text diff with ignore rules, JSON structure-aware comparison that treats key order as irrelevant and detects array reordering, a jumpable change list, and similarity statistics — all computed in a local Rust sidecar.
purpose.zh: 万物皆可对比，不止代码。行级+词级文本对比（可忽略空白/大小写）、JSON 结构感知对比（键序无关、识别数组重排）、可跳转的差异清单与相似度统计，引擎全部在本地 Rust Sidecar 完成。

en: Config review: find what changed between two versions of a config file, down to the exact word
API debugging: compare two JSON responses structurally, ignoring key order and dynamic noise
Proofreading: spot every wording difference between two drafts with word-level highlights
Snippet diffing: quickly compare code or text fragments that are not under version control
zh: 配置审查：两版配置文件改了什么，精确到词
接口调试：两次 JSON 响应结构对比，键序无关、识别数组重排
文稿校对：两段文章逐词看清每处改动
片段比对：未纳入版本控制的代码/文本快速对比

plugins.name: JSON 格式化
plugins.description: JSON 解析、格式化、压缩、JS 处理与多维可视化
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Developers frequently handle complex JSON data when debugging APIs, editing configs, or exchanging data. This plugin integrates formatting, compression, querying, and visualization into one tool.
purpose.zh: 开发者在调试 API、配置文件、数据交换时经常需要处理复杂的 JSON 数据。JSON 格式化插件将格式化、压缩、查询、可视化整合到一个工具中，替代多个在线工具。

en: API debugging: format compressed JSON responses
Config editing: beautify and validate JSON config files
Data analysis: browse large JSON datasets in table view
Data transformation: filter and map JSON with JS processing engine
zh: API 调试：格式化 API 返回的压缩 JSON 响应
配置编辑：美化和验证 JSON 配置文件
数据分析：表格视图浏览大型 JSON 数据集
数据转换：用 JS 处理引擎对 JSON 进行筛选和映射

longDescription.en: JSON Format provides parsing, beautification, compression, JS processing, and multi-dimensional visualization—the Swiss Army knife for developers working with JSON data.
longDescription.zh: JSON 格式化插件提供解析、美化、压缩、JS 处理与多维可视化，是开发者处理 JSON 数据的瑞士军刀。

en: JSON beautify (2/4 space indent) and single-line minify
JS processing engine: custom function body to process JSON data
Multi-dimensional visualization: table, image, tree, text views
Web Worker async processing, zero UI blocking
zh: JSON 美化（2/4 空格缩进）与单行压缩
JS 处理引擎：自定义 JS 函数体处理 JSON 数据
多维可视化：表格、图片、树形、文本视图
Web Worker 异步处理，UI 零阻塞

plugins.name: JSON 转 Excel
plugins.description: 将 JSON 数据一键转换为 Excel 表格，支持嵌套展开、多 Sheet、数据预览
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Manually converting JSON data into Excel spreadsheets is tedious, and online converters pose data privacy risks. This plugin provides a local, offline JSON-to-Excel converter with nested object flattening and multi-sheet support.
purpose.zh: 手动将 JSON 数据转换为 Excel 表格既繁琐又耗时，在线转换工具还存在数据隐私风险。本插件提供本地离线的 JSON 转 Excel 工具，支持嵌套对象自动展开和多 Sheet 导出。

en: API data export: convert API response JSON into Excel for analysis
Data reporting: transform nested JSON structures into flat spreadsheets
Batch data processing: export multiple arrays into separate sheets
Offline conversion: convert sensitive JSON data locally without upload
zh: API 数据导出：将接口返回的 JSON 转换为 Excel 进行分析
数据报表：将嵌套 JSON 结构转换为扁平表格
批量数据处理：将多个数组分别导出到不同工作表
离线转换：敏感 JSON 数据本地转换，无需上传云端

longDescription.en: JSON to Excel is a professional local conversion tool that turns JSON data into Excel spreadsheets with nested object flattening (dot notation), multi-sheet support, data preview, and configurable export options.
longDescription.zh: JSON 转 Excel 是一款专业的本地转换工具，将 JSON 数据转换为 Excel 表格，支持嵌套对象自动展开（dot notation）、多 Sheet 导出、数据预览和可配置导出选项。

en: One-click JSON to Excel conversion
Nested object auto-flattening with dot notation
Multi-sheet export for multiple arrays
Table-based data preview before conversion
Configurable export: header style, empty value handling, auto column width
QuickAction integration: auto-detects JSON text in context panel
zh: 一键 JSON 转 Excel 转换
嵌套对象 dot notation 自动展开
多数组自动分 Sheet 导出
转换前表格化数据预览
可配置导出：表头样式、空值处理、自动列宽
QuickAction 集成：快捷操作面板自动识别 JSON 文本

plugins.name: 密码管理器
plugins.description: 本地零知识加密密码保险库：主密码 + Windows Hello 解锁、密码生成器、安全体检、Popup 快速取密
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Reusing a few passwords across dozens of sites is the norm, and cloud password managers raise privacy concerns. This plugin provides a local zero-knowledge vault: master-password key derivation, field-level AES-256-GCM encryption, instant search-copy with guarded clipboard, and a one-time recovery key.
purpose.zh: 在几十个网站之间复用少量密码是常态，而云端密码管理器又带来隐私顾虑。本插件提供本地零知识加密保险库：主密码派生密钥、字段级 AES-256-GCM 加密、即搜即复制（剪贴板自动清除）与一次性恢复密钥。

en: Quick retrieval: search, copy with countdown auto-clear
Signup: generate a strong random password or passphrase on the spot (usable from the lock screen)
Organize: folders, tags, favorites, recents and per-site default account
Safe backup: export an encrypted .mdvault file to a USB drive, restore with merge or overwrite
zh: 快速取密：即搜即复制，剪贴板倒计时自动清除
注册新账号：现场生成高强度随机密码或口令短语（锁屏态可用）
组织管理：文件夹、标签、收藏、最近使用与同站点默认账号
安全备份：导出加密 .mdvault 文件到 U 盘，合并或覆盖恢复

longDescription.en: Password Manager v2 is a local zero-knowledge encrypted vault, rebuilt from the ground up: master-password key derivation (Argon2id), field-level AES-256-GCM encryption, custom fields, guarded clipboard, encrypted .mdvault backups and a one-time recovery key. Data never leaves your device.
longDescription.zh: 密码管理器 v2 是全新重写的本地零知识加密保险库：主密码派生密钥（Argon2id）、字段级 AES-256-GCM 加密、自定义字段、剪贴板守护、加密 .mdvault 备份与一次性恢复密钥。数据永不出设备。

en: Zero-knowledge local encryption, data never uploaded
Field-level AES-256-GCM with AAD binding (anti-swap hardening)
Custom entry fields with secret masking and guarded copy
Folders / tags / favorites / recents / per-site default account
Search incl. Chinese pinyin initials
Random / passphrase / PIN generator with entropy meter
Clipboard guard with countdown auto-clear
Encrypted .mdvault backup & restore (merge / overwrite)
Recovery key for forgotten master password
zh: 零知识本地加密，数据永不上传
字段级 AES-256-GCM + AAD 绑定（防字段调换加固）
自定义字段：密码型遮蔽显示、复制走守护通道
文件夹 / 标签 / 收藏 / 最近使用 / 同站点默认账号
搜索支持拼音首字母
随机 / 口令短语 / PIN 生成器，实时熵评估
剪贴板守护：倒计时自动清除
加密 .mdvault 备份与恢复（合并 / 覆盖）
恢复密钥：忘记主密码时的自助救援

plugins.name: 番茄钟
plugins.description: 25+5 专注模式，自动短休息/长休息切换，统计记录
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Modern life is full of distractions. This plugin applies the classic Pomodoro Technique (25min focus + 5min break) to help overcome procrastination and build healthy deep work habits.
purpose.zh: 现代生活中干扰无处不在，社交媒体、邮件、消息通知不断打断专注。番茄钟 Pro 基于经典的番茄工作法（25 分钟专注 + 5 分钟休息），帮助你克服拖延症，建立健康的深度工作习惯。

en: Study and exam prep: sustained focus for long study sessions
Remote work: manage work rhythm and avoid prolonged sitting
Project management: break complex tasks into manageable pomodoros
Habit building: maintain daily pomodoro count for consistent rhythm
zh: 学习备考：考研、考证、语言学习等需要长时间专注的场景
远程办公：居家办公时自我管理工作节奏，避免久坐
项目管理：将复杂任务拆解为多个番茄钟，逐步推进
习惯养成：每日固定番茄钟数量，培养稳定的工作节律

longDescription.en: Pomodoro Pro is a focus efficiency tool based on the scientific Pomodoro Technique. Through 25-minute focus + 5-minute break cycles, it helps you overcome procrastination and boost productivity.
longDescription.zh: 番茄钟 Pro 是一款基于科学番茄工作法的专注效率工具。通过 25 分钟专注 + 5 分钟休息的循环，帮助你克服拖延症，提升工作效率。

en: Customizable focus/break durations (5/15/25/45/60 min)
Multiple white noise backgrounds (rain, cafe, fireplace, keyboard)
Task management integration with pomodoro timer binding
Daily/weekly focus statistics with visual charts
Desktop floating window and standalone window dual mode
Focus achievement system and level unlocking
Local encrypted data storage, privacy secured
zh: 自定义专注时长和休息时长（5/15/25/45/60 分钟）
多种白噪音背景音（雨声、咖啡馆、壁炉、键盘声）
任务管理集成，支持番茄计时绑定任务
每日/每周专注数据统计和可视化图表
桌面悬浮窗和独立窗口双模式
专注成就系统和等级解锁
数据本地加密存储，隐私安全

plugins.name: 代理管理
plugins.description: TUN 模式系统级流量路由引擎，虚拟网卡全局流量劫持 + 规则智能路由 + 多代理组管理
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Manually switching proxy nodes in multi-proxy environments is tedious and error-prone. This plugin integrates node management, rule engine, and auto-switching strategies into one tool.
purpose.zh: 在多代理环境下手动切换代理节点既繁琐又容易出错。代理切换插件将节点管理、规则引擎、自动切换策略整合到一个工具中，让网络代理管理变得简单高效。

en: Dev debugging: frequently switch regional proxies for API testing
Network optimization: multi-node management and latency testing
Enterprise network: hybrid config for intranet direct + external proxy
Gaming: route specific game domains to low-latency nodes
zh: 开发调试：需要频繁切换不同地区代理测试 API 可用性
科学上网：多节点管理与延迟测试，选择最优线路
企业网络：内网直连 + 外网代理的混合策略配置
游戏加速：针对特定游戏域名路由到低延迟节点

longDescription.en: Proxy Switch is a professional network proxy management tool that helps you easily manage multiple proxy nodes with a rule engine for automated proxy switching.
longDescription.zh: 代理切换是一款专业的网络代理管理工具，帮助你轻松管理多个代理节点，配合规则引擎实现自动化代理切换。

en: Multi-node management (HTTP/SOCKS5)
Rule engine: domain suffix, keyword, regex, IP-CIDR
Auto-switching strategies
Bypass list (localhost/LAN auto direct)
Real-time request log viewing
Latency testing
zh: 多节点管理（HTTP/SOCKS5）
规则引擎：域名后缀、关键词、正则、IP-CIDR
自动切换策略
绕过列表（localhost/局域网自动直连）
请求日志实时查看
延迟测试

plugins.name: SQL 美化
plugins.description: SQL 格式化、压缩、校验、多语句导航、转换与静态分析
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Developers constantly deal with unformatted SQL: single-line queries from logs, messy scripts written by others, INSERT data to convert. This plugin provides an offline SQL text workbench with formatting, compression, validation, statement navigation, transformations and static analysis — without ever connecting to a database.
purpose.zh: 开发者每天都在和未格式化的 SQL 打交道：日志里捞出来的单行查询、别人写的乱格式脚本、需要转换的 INSERT 数据。本插件提供离线 SQL 文本工作台：格式化、压缩、校验、多语句导航、转换与静态分析，全程不连接数据库。

en: Debugging: format single-line SQL copied from application logs
Script cleanup: split and navigate multi-statement scripts with per-statement type stats
Data conversion: turn INSERT statements into CSV or JSON, DDL into TypeScript interfaces
Quick check: extract involved tables and spot common slow-query patterns
zh: 调试排障：格式化从应用日志里复制出来的单行 SQL
脚本整理：按分号拆分多语句脚本，逐条导航与类型统计
数据转换：INSERT 语句转 CSV/JSON，建表 DDL 转 TypeScript 接口
快速自查：提取涉及的表与字段，识别常见慢查询模式

longDescription.en: An offline SQL workbench built on sql-formatter and CodeMirror 6: format and minify SQL across five dialects (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, T-SQL, PL/SQL), validate parentheses/quotes with line numbers, navigate multi-statement scripts, transform between SQL and CSV/JSON/TypeScript, analyze involved tables and slow-query patterns, manage snippets and formatting history, open and save .sql files — all fully local. Deep QuickAction integration lets you format selected SQL from any application.
longDescription.zh: 基于 sql-formatter 与 CodeMirror 6 的离线 SQL 工作台：五方言（MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQLite/T-SQL/PL-SQL）格式化与压缩、括号/引号校验定位到行、多语句导航、SQL 与 CSV/JSON/TypeScript 互转、涉及表与慢查询模式分析、片段库与格式化历史、.sql 文件读写——全部本地完成。深度集成 QuickAction，任意应用中选中 SQL 即可一键格式化。

en: Format SQL in 5 dialects with presets and configurable style options
Minify SQL with string-literal protection
Syntax quick-check (parentheses/quotes) with line-numbered errors
Multi-statement split with clickable statement chips
Transform: SELECT→COUNT, DDL→TypeScript, INSERT→CSV/JSON
Static analysis: table/field extraction and slow-query pattern hints
Snippet library and formatting history (persisted locally)
Open/save .sql files via native dialogs
QuickAction: format selected SQL from anywhere, with statement-stats preview
zh: 五方言 SQL 格式化，预设 + 选项自由定制风格
SQL 压缩单行化，字符串字面量保护
括号/引号语法快检，错误定位到行
多语句拆分，语句标签点击跳转
转换：SELECT→COUNT、DDL→TypeScript、INSERT→CSV/JSON
静态分析：涉及表/字段提取与慢查询模式提示
片段库与格式化历史（本地持久化）
.sql 文件原生对话框打开/保存
QuickAction：任意应用选中 SQL 一键格式化，含语句统计预览卡

plugins.name: 系统信息
plugins.description: 系统信息一站式工具箱：工具树式浏览硬件/系统/网络/进程/外设，实时监控 CPU·内存·磁盘·网速，查看 WiFi 密码、VPN 凭据、产品密钥、BitLocker 恢复密钥并导出报告
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: When troubleshooting hardware, upgrading configs, or diagnosing networks, users need a quick system overview. This plugin consolidates scattered system tools into a unified interface.
purpose.zh: 在排查硬件问题、升级配置、网络诊断时，用户需要快速获取系统全貌。系统信息插件将分散在各处的系统工具整合为统一界面，一站式查看所有关键信息。

en: Hardware checkup: confirm current specs before purchasing upgrades
Network diagnostics: check IP config, WiFi signal, connectivity
Performance analysis: monitor CPU/memory/disk usage
Peripheral inspection: verify USB devices and listening ports
zh: 硬件排查：购买新硬件前确认当前配置和接口
网络诊断：检查 IP 配置、WiFi 信号、连通性
性能分析：查看 CPU/内存/磁盘使用率
外设检查：确认 USB 设备和监听端口状态

longDescription.en: System Info v2: explorer-style tree for hardware, system, network, processes and peripherals; realtime CPU/memory/disk/network monitoring; view WiFi passwords, VPN credentials, Windows product keys and BitLocker recovery keys; export TXT/Markdown/JSON reports.
longDescription.zh: 系统信息插件 v2：工具树式一站式查看硬件、系统、网络、进程与外设信息；实时监控 CPU/内存/磁盘/网速；查看 WiFi 密码、VPN 凭据、Windows 产品密钥、BitLocker 恢复密钥；导出 TXT/Markdown/JSON 报告。

en: Explorer tree navigation: summary plus 26 info pages across hardware/system/network/processes/secrets/peripherals
Realtime monitoring: CPU, memory, disk and network gauges (off by default, 2s refresh, pauses when hidden)
Passwords & keys: WiFi passwords (incl. WPA3), VPN credentials (built-in/WireGuard/OpenVPN), Windows product keys, BitLocker recovery keys, auto-logon password, Credential Manager
System health: activation, Defender, TPM, Secure Boot, power plan, page file
Full hardware: live CPU clock, memory slot layout, NVMe bus type, accurate GPU VRAM, battery health, disk SMART
Report export: TXT / Markdown / JSON with optional passwords & keys
zh: 工具树导航：摘要 + 硬件/系统/网络/进程与应用/密码与密钥/外设与端口 26 类信息
实时监控：CPU·内存·磁盘·网速四指标环（默认关闭，2s 刷新，隐藏窗口自动暂停）
密码与密钥：WiFi 密码（含 WPA3）、VPN 凭据（内置/WireGuard/OpenVPN）、Windows 产品密钥、BitLocker 恢复密钥、自动登录密码、凭据管理器
系统健康：激活状态、Defender、TPM、安全启动、电源计划、页面文件
硬件全量：CPU 当前频率、内存插槽布局、NVMe BusType、GPU 显存精确值、电池健康度、磁盘 SMART
报告导出：TXT / Markdown / JSON，可选包含密码与密钥

plugins.name: XML 格式化
plugins.description: XML 格式化、压缩、校验、结构树、XPath 查询与 JSON 互转
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Developers constantly handle unformatted XML: SOAP requests, pom.xml, Android layouts, RSS feeds and sitemaps. This plugin provides an offline XML workbench with formatting, minifying, well-formedness validation with line/column location, structure tree browsing, XPath 1.0 queries and bidirectional XML-JSON conversion — all fully local.
purpose.zh: 开发者每天都在和未格式化的 XML 打交道：SOAP 报文、pom.xml、Android 布局、RSS 与 sitemap。本插件提供离线 XML 文本工作台：格式化、压缩、校验（定位到行:列）、结构树浏览、XPath 查询与 XML⇄JSON 双向转换，全程本地完成。

en: API debugging: format compressed XML/SOAP requests and locate fields in the structure tree
Config cleanup: beautify messy pom.xml / Android layout / .NET config files
Data extraction: run XPath queries against the document and jump to matched nodes
Data conversion: turn XML into JSON and back for config migration
zh: 接口调试：格式化压缩的 XML/SOAP 报文，结构树里快速定位字段
配置整理：美化混乱的 pom.xml / Android 布局 / .NET 配置
数据抽取：XPath 查询文档，命中节点一键跳转
数据转换：XML 转 JSON、JSON 转 XML，配置迁移好帮手

longDescription.en: An offline XML workbench built on quick-xml (Rust sidecar) and CodeMirror 6: pretty-print with 2/4-space or tab indentation while preserving comments, CDATA, declarations and PIs; minify to one line with text protection; well-formedness validation reporting multiple issues with line:column location; structure tree with click-to-jump navigation and document stats; full XPath 1.0 queries via sxd-xpath with result locating; bidirectional XML-JSON conversion with attribute-prefix/array/#text conventions; entity escape/unescape; .xml file open/save — all local.
longDescription.zh: 基于 quick-xml（Rust sidecar）与 CodeMirror 6 的离线 XML 工作台：2/4 空格或 Tab 缩进格式化（注释/CDATA/声明/PI 完整保留）、单行压缩（文本内容保护）、well-formedness 多错误校验（定位到行:列）、结构树点击跳转与文档统计、sxd-xpath 全量 XPath 1.0 查询（结果回定位）、XML⇄JSON 双向转换（属性前缀/数组/#text 约定）、实体转义互转、.xml 文件读写——全部本地完成。

en: Format XML with 2/4-space or tab indentation, preserving comments/CDATA/decl/PIs
Minify to a single line with text and CDATA protection
Well-formedness validation reporting multiple errors with line:column
Structure tree with collapse/expand and click-to-jump locating
Document stats: elements/attributes/depth/size/CDATA/comments
Full XPath 1.0 queries with result locating
Bidirectional XML-JSON conversion (attribute prefix, arrays, #text)
Entity escape/unescape (named + numeric)
Open/save .xml files via native dialogs
QuickAction: structure preview card, error-locating card, 5 context-menu direct actions
zh: XML 格式化：2/4 空格或 Tab 缩进，注释/CDATA/声明/PI 保留
压缩单行化：文本内容与 CDATA 保护
well-formedness 校验：多错误一次报全，定位到行:列
结构树浏览：折叠/展开，点击节点跳转结果行
文档统计：元素/属性/深度/体积/CDATA/注释
XPath 1.0 全量查询，结果点击回定位
XML⇄JSON 双向转换（属性前缀/重复元素合数组/#text）
实体转义/反转义（命名 + 数值实体）
.xml 文件原生对话框打开/保存
QuickAction：结构结论卡/破损定位卡 + 右键 5 条直达

plugins.name: YAML 格式化
plugins.description: YAML 格式化、校验、压缩、JSON 互转、扁平化与多文档处理
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Developers handle YAML constantly when editing Kubernetes manifests, CI pipelines and app configs. This plugin integrates formatting with comment preservation, validation with line/column location, minifying, YAML-JSON conversion, flattening and multi-document handling into one offline workbench.
purpose.zh: 开发者频繁处理 K8s 清单、CI 流水线与应用配置中的 YAML。本插件把保留注释的格式化、行列级校验定位、压缩、YAML-JSON 互转、扁平化与多文档处理整合为一个离线工作台。

en: Config editing: beautify messy YAML while keeping comments and key order
K8s debugging: validate multi-document manifests and locate the exact broken line
Data exchange: convert between YAML and JSON both ways
Env migration: flatten nested YAML into dot-notation keys and export .env style
zh: 配置整理：把凌乱的 YAML 排版整齐，同时保留 # 注释与键顺序
K8s 排障：多文档清单逐文档校验，错误精确定位到行列
数据交换：YAML 与 JSON 双向互转
环境迁移：嵌套结构扁平化为点号键值，导出 .env 风格文本
